parameters.name: configurationId
parameters.description: The pipeline configuration ID corresponding to the work item type. This value can be obtained from the following page API request: https://devops.aliyun.com/projex/api/workitem/workitemType/setting/space/getSpaceWorkitemTypeScope?spaceType=Project&spaceIdentifier=c595d0c3df4c743ac811......&workitemTypeIdentifier=ba102e46bc6a8483...... The corresponding Field Value is located in result → configurations → identifier where configType is Workflow.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: workitemId
parameters.description: Work item ID, same as the workitemIdentifier field, which is the UUID of the work item
